svg.title: Plate PL-04 — The cell: an engineered system with a budget
svg.desc: A labelled anatomical plate of a schematic cell. Nine numbered call-outs (plasma membrane, nucleus, mitochondrion, ATP synthase, ribosome, microtubule with kinesin, actin cortex, cytoplasm, receptor) each carry a measured value with units and an evidence class. Four detail figures enlarge the membrane in section, the F1 rotary motor, kinesin on a microtubule, and the ribosome. A budget table compares Escherichia coli with a mammalian cell. The drawing is schematic and not to scale; only the printed numbers are claims. Every number resolves to a row of the NATURE-LEDGER. Primary source: chapter NA-08, cell-level design.
svg.text: UNI Encyclopedia of Nature · Wing NATURA · Plate PL-04
The Cell — an engineered system with a budget
Every label carries its measured value, its units, its scope and its evidence class. Where the corpus has no sourced number, the label says so.
SECONDARY · NA-10 scale ladder · CN-05 dna · CN-11 humans
EVERY NUMBER RESOLVES TO A ROW OF NATURE-LEDGER.md — OR SAYS, IN PLACE, THAT IT DOES NOT
ℓ_p ≈ 17.7 µm — ≈294× softer than a microtubule
≈20 aa/s (E. coli) · 4 ATP per peptide bond
diameter NOT-SOURCED · V ≈ 113 µm³ (modelled, d = 6 µm)
2.08 m of DNA in ~5.8% of the volume · ε_final 10⁻⁸–10⁻¹⁰/nt
Not to scale, and not to any one organism. No drawn size, spacing or count on this figure is a measurement.
THE DETAILS, AT NO STATED MAGNIFICATION

text.tspan: Bilayer thickness d = 4–5 nm OBS-REP [NA08-31]; a resting
neuron holds V_m ≈ −70 mV OBS-REP [NA08-32]. Divide:
E_m = V/d = 1.4–1.8 × 10⁷ V/m MODEL [NA08-33]. Dry air at
1 atm breaks down at ≈3 × 10⁶ V/m [NA08-34] — so the
membrane sustains ≈5× the field that makes air spark,
continuously, for decades, across a structure two molecules
thick. That is not a metaphor; it is V/d. Specific capacitance
C_m ≈ 1 µF/cm² (0.01 F/m²) OBS-REP [NA08-35], near-invariant
across cell types — bilayer thickness barely moves.
Noji et al. 1997 fixed an actin filament to the γ subunit and
watched it turn: one revolution = three discrete 120° steps,
each driven by one ATP. Torque τ_F1 ≈ 40 pN·nm, constant
across load and speed OBS-REP [NA08-14]. Work per 120° step
≈80 pN·nm against ≈90 pN·nm of available ATP free energy
OBS-REP [NA08-15] — it runs near the thermodynamic ceiling.
ω_F1 ≈ 130 rev/s at saturating ATP, the 120° resolving into
~90° + ~30° substeps OBS-REP [NA08-16]. In vivo ΔG_ATP =
A 1 m axon cannot deliver a protein by diffusion — that would
take ~195 yr [NA08-03]. So it does not: kinesin walks the cargo.
Step d_kin = 8 nm OBS-REP [NA08-17], one ATP per 8-nm step
OBS-REP [NA08-18], v_kin ≈ 0.5–1 µm/s (commonly ~0.8) at
saturating ATP, near-zero load, in vitro OBS-REP [NA08-20].
Stall force F_stall,kin = 5–6 pN (Svoboda & Block 1994) OR 7–8 pN
(force clamp, Visscher et al. 1999) OBS-CON [NA08-19].
Carry both. Name the assay. Do not average them — the spread
is the measurement's, and averaging it away invents a number.
Rate r_rib,ec ≈ 20 aa/s (range 4–22, growth-rate dependent)
OBS-REP [NA08-23]; r_rib,euk = 3–10 aa/s (yeast, 30 °C), ≈6 aa/s
(mouse ES) OBS-REP [NA08-24]. Error ε_rib = 10⁻⁴–10⁻³ per
codon OBS-REP [NA08-25], against ε_final = 10⁻⁸–10⁻¹⁰/nt
[NA08-30]: 10⁴–10⁷× sloppier MODEL — the full span those two
rows allow, and it sets per-codon against per-nt. Sloppier is a
design choice, not a defect: proteins are disposable, the genome
is not. Each peptide bond costs c_pep = 4 ATP OBS-REP [NA08-10]
— 2 from pyrophosphate release at tRNA charging, 1 GTP for each
of two elongation factors. Building the polymer is the budget.

svg.text: THE BUDGET — A JUST-IN-TIME SYSTEM WITH NO RESERVOIR
~3 × 10⁻¹⁰ W (NA-08 energy table; BNID 111474/111475 — no ledger row)

text.tspan: growing; glucose minimal media
fibroblast, ~3,000 µm³

svg.text: ion pumping — ≈50%, via the Na⁺/K⁺-ATPase (grey matter) (NA-08; A&L 2001 + Howarth 2012 — no ledger row)
c_pep = 4 ATP per peptide bond OBS-REP [NA08-10]
Signalling split: action potentials 47 / postsynaptic glutamate 34 /
DNA, lipid and wall synthesis are rounding
resting potential 13 / glutamate recycling 3 (% of signalling ATP)
MODEL [NA08-48] — a modelled apportionment for rodent grey matter,
not per-process measurement. Attwell & Laughlin 2001: cite only with
the Howarth, Gleeson & Attwell 2012 revision named.

text.tspan: NO RESERVOIR. NA-08 states that E. coli turns over its entire ATP
pool in about one second. This pass located no primary for that
figure, so it is carried NOT-SRC and not as a measurement.
Falsifier: produce the primary source, or strike the value. The
lesson it carries is the chapter's: there is no buffer, which is
why the cell's power supply cannot be interrupted.

svg.text: THE CEILING — WHAT SETS THE SIZE, AND WHAT IT COSTS TO EXCEED IT

text.tspan: Two constraints, both punishing size, both quadratic-or-worse. SURFACE. S/V = 3/R — ≈6 µm⁻¹ at R = 0.5 µm (E. coli) against ≈0.3 µm⁻¹ at R = 10 µm
(mammalian) MODEL [NA08-04] — a 20-fold cut in nutrient-flux area per unit of metabolising cytoplasm. Volume grows as R³, uptake area as R²: growth is self-strangling.
TRANSPORT. t ≈ L²/(6D), taking D = 27 µm²/s OBS-REP [NA08-02] — 1 µm → 6.2 ms (free) · 10 µm → 0.62 s (tolerable) · 100 µm → 62 s (already a problem) ·
1 mm → ~1.7 h (broken) · 1 m → ~6.2 × 10⁹ s ≈ 195 yr MODEL [NA08-03]. The exponent is the whole story: distance is quadratic in time; double the cell, quadruple the wait.
A motor neuron running from spinal cord to toe cannot use diffusion — not inefficiently, not at all. Kinesin at ~0.8 µm/s covers 1 m in ~1.25 × 10⁶ s ≈ 14 d MODEL, computed
in-chapter from v_kin [NA08-20]: a motor beats diffusion by ~4 orders of magnitude over that span. E. coli sits at ~1 µm × ~2 µm, ~1 µm³ ≈ 1 fL (NA-08; BNID 100004; Milo &
Phillips 2015 — no ledger row), inside the band where diffusion is still free. THE APPARENT EXCEPTION. Thiomargarita namibiensis reaches 750 µm OBS-REP [NA08-05] — but
80–98% of its volume is a nitrate vacuole and its living cytoplasm is a shell ~1–2 µm thick OBS-REP [NA08-06]. The diffusion length that carries the flux is still ~1–2 µm. It got big
by making most of itself not cytoplasm. The constraint was obeyed, not defeated — when a case looks like a counterexample, find the length scale that actually carries the flux.
1 · PLASMA MEMBRANE — FIG. 2
d_bilayer = 4–5 nm OBS-REP [NA08-31]. V_m ≈ −70 mV OBS-REP
(resting neuron) [NA08-32]. E_m = 1.4–1.8 × 10⁷ V/m MODEL
[NA08-33] — computed as V/d from the two rows above, not
measured directly; the assumptions are the fence. C_m ≈ 1 µF/cm²
(0.01 F/m²) OBS-REP [NA08-35], near-invariant across cell types.
Why a bilayer and nothing else: it is the only structure that is
at once self-assembling, self-healing, fluid enough for embedded
proteins to diffuse, and insulating enough to hold 10⁷ V/m.
2 · NUCLEUS
Diameter: NOT-SRC — this corpus carries no sourced measurement.
CN-05 assumes a sphere, d = 6 µm, to model volume: V_nucleus ≈
113 µm³ MODEL [CN05-38]. L_DNA = 1.04 m haploid (2.08 m diploid)
MODEL [CN05-37]; f_DNA,vol ≈ 5.8% of nuclear volume MODEL
[CN05-39] — the nucleus is ~94% not-DNA, so packing is a topology
and access problem, not a space problem. Volume was never the
constraint. Linear packing ratio ≈ 3.5 × 10⁵ MODEL [CN05-40].
Genome fidelity ε_final = 10⁻⁸–10⁻¹⁰ per nt OBS-REP [NA08-30] — a
systems property, not a component property, bought with three
cheap layers: polymerase selectivity alone ε_pol ≈ 10⁻⁴–10⁻⁵
[NA08-28], + exonucleolytic proofreading ≈ 10⁻⁶–10⁻⁷ [NA08-29],
+ mismatch repair. Quoting 10⁻¹⁰ as the polymerase's own error
rate is the recorded conflation trap. Chromatin is drawn as a
disordered curvilinear chain (Ou et al. 2017); the 30-nm fibre is
OBS-CON in vivo [CN05-42] and is deliberately not drawn here.
3 · MITOCHONDRION
Length: NOT-SRC. NA-10's scale ladder prints a rung-6 value;
that chapter's own gate struck it as carrying no source, and this
plate does not re-import it. Characteristic time: NOT-MEAS as a
single quantity [NA-10, rung 6]. The two fences are not inter-
changeable: NOT-MEAS is nature's absence, NOT-SRC is ours.
Own genome: 16,569 bp (human mtDNA, T2T-CHM13) OBS-REP
[CN05-17]. Blanket: double membrane, own genome, own fission
[NA-10, rung 6] — a former rung-7 blanket demoted to an
organelle's. Observables named, values not carried here: ΔΨm and
ATP flux. A micron across, and it has a boundary; a galaxy is
enormous and has none. Size is not what makes a blanket.
4 · ATP SYNTHASE (F₁) — FIG. 3
τ_F1 ≈ 40 pN·nm OBS-REP [NA08-14] — torque constant across load
and speed. One revolution = three discrete 120° steps, each driven
by one ATP; each 120° resolves into ~90° + ~30° substeps.
W_F1 ≈ 80 pN·nm per 120° step against ~90 pN·nm available
OBS-REP [NA08-15] — operating near the thermodynamic ceiling.
ω_F1 ≈ 130 rev/s at saturating ATP OBS-REP [NA08-16]. The
free energy it works against: in vivo ΔG_ATP = −47 to −50 kJ/mol
(≈20 k_BT ≈ 80–90 pN·nm) OBS-REP [NA08-12] — which is not the
standard-condition ΔG°' = −28 to −34 kJ/mol (≈12 k_BT) OBS-REP
[NA08-13]. The two are measured at different conditions, they
differ by ~8 k_BT, and swapping them breaks the energy budget.
5 · RIBOSOME — FIG. 5
Diameter: NOT-SRC — no sourced row in this corpus. See Fig. 5
for rate, error and cost, all of which are sourced.
6 · MICROTUBULE + KINESIN — FIG. 4
Kinesin's numbers are at Fig. 4. The rail it walks on:
OBS-REP [NA08-36], taxol-stabilised, flexural rigidity (Gittes et
al. 1993). Persistence length ℓ_p,MT ≈ 5,200 µm — 5.2 mm — from
ℓ_p = κ/k_BT OBS-REP [NA08-37]: a filament nanometres wide whose
bending length is millimetres. Fenced: whether ℓ_p,MT varies with
filament length is contested OBS-CON [NA08-38] — Pampaloni et
al. 2006 report a length-dependence, which contradicts a single
MT constant. Both positions travel; neither is resolved here.
7 · ACTIN CORTEX
ℓ_p,actin ≈ 17.7 µm OBS-REP (rhodamine-phalloidin) [NA08-39].
Ratio ℓ_p,MT/ℓ_p,actin ≈ 294 (~300×) MODEL [NA08-40] — computed
from the two Gittes et al. 1993 values: one stiff beam and one
flexible cable, in the same cytoplasm, from one paper.
8 · CYTOPLASM — THE REGIME
Re ≈ 6 × 10⁻⁵ MODEL [NA08-43] (E. coli: v ≈ 3 × 10⁻⁵ m/s, L = 2 µm,
ρ = 10³ kg/m³, µ = 10⁻³ Pa·s; inputs order-of-magnitude, Purcell
1977) — inertia does not exist; stop coasting. Pe ≈ 0.06–0.1
MODEL [NA08-44] (D ~ 10⁻⁹ m²/s, small molecule) — stirring is
useless at this scale: you cannot mix your way out, you can only
wait or pump. D_GFP,euk = 27 µm²/s OBS-REP (GFP-S65T, CHO)
[NA08-02]; D_GFP,ec = 7.7 ± 2.5 µm²/s OBS-REP (GFP 27 kDa,
E. coli, FRAP) [NA08-01]. Convention: t ≈ L²/(6D) is 3D. State it.
9 · RECEPTOR — THE SENSING FLOOR
δc/c ~ (D·a·c·T)^(−1/2) OBS-REP as a scaling [NA08-41] (Berg &
Purcell 1977). To halve the error, quadruple the integration time:
a speed–accuracy tradeoff derived from physics. The prefactor is
disputed OBS-CON [NA08-42] — Kaizu et al. 2014 report a factor
1/(2(1−n̄)) missing from Bialek & Setayeshgar 2005. The scaling is
settled; the constant is not, so no closed form is printed here.
OBS-REP OBSERVED-REPLICATED · OBS-CON OBSERVED-CONTESTED ·
MODEL MODELED · NOT-SRC NOT-SOURCED · NOT-MEAS NOT-MEASURED.
Abbreviated for the plate; canonical strings in NA-00 (twelve classes,
three groups) and in NATURE-LEDGER.md. MODEL means the assumptions
are the fence. OBS-CON means both positions are carried on purpose.
NOT-MEASURED and NOT-SOURCED are never merged — nature has not been
asked, versus we cannot say who asked. One gap is nature's, one is ours;
they take different repairs, and collapsing them lets a research failure
pass as a discovery about the frontier. [NA08-31] = a row id in
encyclopedia/NATURE-LEDGER.md, carrying its own scope, source and
falsifier. THREE NUMBERS HERE HAVE NO LEDGER ROW — mammalian power,
E. coli size, and the ion-pumping share. Each traces to NA-08 on disk and
names its source in place, but no row carries its scope and falsifier. They
are a repair queue against the ledger, not a licence. Colour carries no
meaning here — the plate reads identically in greyscale. HATCHING:
diagonal = cytoplasm · stipple = nucleoplasm · horizontal = mitochondrial
matrix · double line = a lipid bilayer.
NOT TO SCALE. No drawn dimension, proportion, position or count on
this plate is a measurement. The drawing is schematic throughout; only
the printed numbers are claims. A 4–5 nm bilayer and a 6 µm nucleus
cannot share one drawing at one scale, and this one does not try.
NOT ONE CELL. The figure is a composite. E. coli-scoped and mammalian-
scoped numbers are labelled by scope and are never averaged. No
organism has this budget.
NOT AN OPTIMUM. Per Gould & Lewontin (1979), nothing here establishes
any cellular feature as optimal. Phylogenetic inertia, drift, constraint
and contingency produce features that solve nothing. Nature's authority
is precisely and only this: it ran a very long parallel search under real
physical constraints in which the failures were deleted. That makes
every number here a hypothesis generator, not a proof.
NOT A UNI GATE. Every class on this plate is NATURA — nature's observed
regularities. A nature citation NEVER raises a UNI rung. The NATURA
vocabulary and the UNI ledger vocabulary (proven / designed /
hypothesized / not-yet-built) describe different kinds of claim and
never merge. This plate contains zero UNI claims.
NOT COGNITION. "Bounded inference" at 9 is a statistical description of
a physical process. Nothing here claims that a cell is aware, sentient,
or that it knows anything. Berg & Purcell bound an estimate; a bound is
not an experience.
NOT A CONSTRUCTION PLAN. Nothing here is a roadmap to building a cell,
and nothing here bears on "full human" or "beyond human" — permanent
open questions, never targets, never deliverables.
NOT EXHAUSTIVE. Cytoplasmic streaming, syncytia and multinucleation are
named size-ceiling workarounds and are not analysed here.
